case_number: Criminal Appeal No.          of 2022; Arising out of SLP (Crl.) 5866 of 2022
summary: Quashing of FIR under Section 482 Cr.P.C.; allegations of civil dispute mischaracterized as criminal; mala fide intent; forgery, cheating, assault claims; High Court's failure to consider suppression of facts; inherent powers exercise for abuse prevention; criminal proceedings based on pending civil suit.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order set aside; FIR quashed.
